title: Sticks
description: Makes grass blocks have a chance of having a stick on its top texture. Works with any resource pack.
body:
![About](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/19d332cdab77737cd016fd7c1ae13efef260cbc7_0.webp)

**Sticks** gives grass blocks the chance of having a stick on its top texture. The models also include rotation.
